claims.claim: The author has seven current, first-person red lines
claims.stopping_point: Not a universal ethics code and not exhaustive

claims.claim: Missing or unresolved required context cannot produce COMPLIANT
claims.stopping_point: A verified record is still not independently true

claims.claim: Outside-scope work is distinct from compliance
claims.stopping_point: Outside scope means only that this registry did not match

claims.claim: Less retained oversight narrows the release envelope
claims.stopping_point: Oversight retention is not safety, legality, or enforcement

claims.claim: A named authorization does not release a block
claims.stopping_point: The author remains the sole local enforcer

claims.claim: Registry changes can be detected against a prior
claims.stopping_point: Same-repository regeneration is self-referential; no signature or non-forgeability

claims.claim: The scholarship widens the questions asked of the instrument
claims.stopping_point: It is not a systematic review, global representation, or source endorsement

claims.claim: The rendered artifact is bound to the source tree for a specific validation run
claims.stopping_point: This is a per-run source-to-render claim; current pre-publication status, renderer boundary, and build-tool trust remain external residual risks

claims.claim: Structured assessment records preserve why a result blocked or passed
claims.stopping_point: Codes preserve the local decision trace; they do not establish semantic truth or honest input

claims.claim: Every source-driven figure carries a bounded caption, alt text, and source binding
claims.stopping_point: Caption and source binding constrain interpretation; they do not make the underlying source or action true
